khāṇu.cp: masc. & neut. a stump; stake; a small post.
khāṇu.p: [Khanu+ṇu] (pu,na) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.549.] (A) A tree stump. (B) A small piece of firewood.

O:
khaṇu：ခဏု
ဘူ = အဝဒါရဏေ-တူးဖြို（ဖောက်ခွဲ）ခြင်း၌။ ခဏတိ။
တနာ = ဝဓေ-သတ်ပုတ်ညှဉ်းဆဲခြင်း၌။ ခဏောတိ၊ ခဏုတေ။

khanu：ခနု
ဘူ = ဝိဒါရဏေ-တူးဖြိုဖောက်ခွဲခြင်း၌။ ခနတိ။
B:
khāṇu： khāṇu（pu，na）
ခါဏု（ပု၊န）
[khanu+ṇu．，ṭī．549．]
[ခနု+ဏု။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၅၄၉။]
C: khāṇu：[m．； nt．] a stump； stake； a small post．
P: Khāṇu，[also often spelled khānu； prob．=Sk．sthāṇu，corrupted in etym．with khaṇati，cp．Trenckner，Notes 58，n．6] a stump （of a tree），a stake．Often used in description of uneven roads； together with kaṇṭaka，thorns A．I，35； III，389； Vism．261 （°paharaṇ’aggi），342 （°magga）； SnA 334．-- jhāma° a burnt stump （as characteristic of kālaka） S．IV，193．-- nikhāta° an uprooted trunk DA．I，73．Khāṇu-kondañña N．of a Thera Vism．380； DhA．II，254．（Page 235）
K:
khāṇu：ခါဏု （ပု၊န）
[ခနု+ဏု။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၅၄၉။]
（က） ငုတ်၊ သစ်ငုတ်။ （ခ） ထင်းနုပ်၊ ထင်းဖွဲ့။
R:
khāṇu：ခါဏု （ပ）
သစ်ငုတ်။ တံသင်း။ ခံသောခု။
DOP: khāṇu khānu ( occasionally written ), m.n. [ BHS, AMg khāṇu; < *skhāṇu, cf S. sthāṇu and K.R. Norman, 1986, p. 391 ], 1. a stump (of a tree); a trunk ; Abh 549; Vin I 188, 15 (bhikkhū … andhakāre ~uṃ pi kaṇṭakaṃ pi akkamanti); S I 127, 17* (~uṃ va urasāsajja); Ja IV 93, 5* (~uṃ pādena ghaṭṭeti; 93, 7´ : ~un ti tattha tattha patitaṃ rukkhakaḷiṅgaraṃ); 483, 25* (sākhāhi rukkho labhate samaññaṃ pahīnasākhaṃ pana ~um āhu); Ap 270, 3 (~uṃ vā kaṇṭakaṃ vā pi nāhaṃ passāmi cakkhunā); Sp 359, 10 (rukkhe vā ~umhi vā); 466, 27 (~unā vā bhijjeyya); Ps I 145, 15 (ayaṃ mahallakatthero bhagavato purato ~u viya nisīdati); — ifc see jhāma-, harita-; — 2. a stake; a post ; — ifc see loha-, vati-; — °- korakāla , m. [khāṇu + kora 1 ], the time when there are (merely) buds on a trunk ;? Ja II 265, 19 (~e kiṃsukaṃ dassesi … kiṃsuko nāma kīdiso ti … seyyathāpi jhāmathūṇo ti, Ee so, perhaps wr; Ce khāṇukoraka-; Be, Se khāṇukakāle; cf Spk III 58, 7 : kīdiso pana bho kiṃsuko ti, jhāpitagāme ṭhitajhāmathūṇo viyā ti … tena hi diṭṭhakāle kiṃsuko patitapatto khāṇukakāle diṭṭhattā tādiso va ahosi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee patitapattakhāṇukāle); — °- ghāta , m ( fn ). [ cf S. sthāṇuccheda], (one) who destroys stumps, who clears away timber ; Ja IV 362, 27* (~-samā rāja te pi vuccanti brāhmaṇā; 366, 8´ foll. : malinasarīratāya jhāmakhettakhāṇughātehi bhūmiṃ khaṇitvā jhāmakhāṇuka-uddharaṇakamanussehi samānā, agahetvā na gamissāmā ti niccalabhāvena ṭhitattā nikhaṇitvā thapitavatikhāṇū viyā ti pi attho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se jhāmakhette khāṇughātakehi … ṭhapitavatikhāṇukā viyā ti pi …); — °- ma(t) , mfn. , containing stumps ;? Sadd 145, 17* (°-mā bhaṇumā); — see also avihata-khāṇuka sv vihanati .
NCP: masculine neuter | khaa.nu (occasionally written as khānu) a stump (of a tree); a trunk.

a: ငုတ်၊ သစ်ငုတ်။

C: khaṇuka：[m．] a stump； stake； a small post．
R: khāṇuka：ခါဏု-က ခါဏု
B:
khāṇuka： khāṇuka（pu，na）
ခါဏုက（ပု၊န）
[khāṇu+ka]
[ခါဏု+က]
P: Khāṇuka，=khāṇu S．V，379 （avihata°）：J．II，18，154； V，45 （loha-daṇḍa-kh° pins & stakes of brass）； Miln．187 （mūle vā khāṇuke vā ．．．khalitvā stumbling over roots & stumps）； Vism．381=DhA．II，254 （with ref．to the name of Khāṇu-kondañña who by robbers was mistaken for a tree stump）； VvA．338 （in a road=saṅkuka）．（Page 235）
K:
khāṇuka：ခါဏုက （ပု၊န）
[ခါဏု+က]
ငုတ်၊ သစ်ငုတ်။
DOP: khāṇuka ( and, sometimes, khānuka), m. [khāṇu + ka 2 ], a stump; a stake, a post ; Ja II 18, 15 (hatthi khadirakhāṇukaṃ akkami, tasso so ~o pādaṃ vijjhi, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se khānuko); 154, 13 (luddo kacchapaṃ pasibbake pakkhipitvā ekasmiṃ ~e laggesi); V 47, 6 (vajiraggena lohadaṇḍena pabbataṃ vijjhitvā ~aṃ koṭṭetvā); Mil 187, 11 (mūle vā ~e vā pāsāṇe vā … khalitvā patati); Vism 381, 3 (~o ayan ti maññamānā); Sp 1207, 16 (udake cattāro ~e nikkhaṇitvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee khānuke); Spk I 90, 19 (sīlatthambho viya ~o viya ca thaddho hutvā tiṭṭhati); II 212, 3 (assā cattāro pāde catusu ~esu bandhitvā); III 58, 7 (kīdiso pana bho kiṃsuko ti, jhāpitagāme ṭhitajhāmathūṇo viyā ti … tena hi diṭṭhakāle kiṃsuko patitapatto °-kāle diṭṭhattā tādiso va ahosi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee patitapattakhāṇukāle); Ud-a 421, 19 (idha pāsāṇo vā ~o vā atthī ti jānanti); As 367, 14 (cīvaraṃ pārupituṃ asakkonto vātassa kuppati upakkhalitvā ~assa kuppati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee khānukassa); — ifc see aya- sv aya(s ).

khāṇukaṇṭakamagga.p: [Khāṇukaṇṭaka+magga] (pu) CL=7 A path (or) way that has many stumps.
a: ခါဏုကဏ္ဋကမဂ္ဂ(ပု)
[ခါဏုကဏ္ဋက+မဂ္ဂ]

B:
khāṇukaṇṭakamagga： khāṇukaṇṭakamagga（pu）
ခါဏုကဏ္ဋကမဂ္ဂ（ပု）
[khāṇukaṇṭaka+magga]
[ခါဏုကဏ္ဋက+မဂ္ဂ]
K:
khāṇukaṇṭakamagga：ခါဏုကဏ္ဋကမဂ္ဂ（ပု）
[ခါဏုကဏ္ဋက+မဂ္ဂ]
သစ်ငုတ်，ဆူးငြောင့်ရှိသော-လမ်း-ခရီး။

khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhāna.p: [Khāṇu+kaṇṭaka+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The located place of a stump.
a: ခါဏုကဏ္ဋကဋ္ဌာန(န)
[ခါဏု+ကဏ္ဋက+ဌာန]
ငုတ်, ဆူးငြောင့်၏ တည်ရာအရပ်။

ခါဏုကဏ္ဋကဋ္ဌာန（န）
[khāṇu+kaṇṭaka+ṭhāna]

khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhāna：ခါဏုကဏ္ဋကဋ္ဌာန （န）

khāṇumata.p: [Khāṇu+mata¿] (na) CL=7 (A Brahmin village) is named Khāṇumata.
a: ခါဏုမတရွာ(ပုဏ္ဏားရွာ)။

B:
khāṇumata： khāṇumata（na）
ခါဏုမတ（န）
[khāṇu+mata¿]
[ခါဏု+မတ¿]
K:
khāṇumata：ခါဏုမတ （န）
[ခါဏု+မတ¿]
ခါဏုမတရွာ （ပုဏ္ဏားရွာ）။
V:
Khānumata：A brahmin village of Magadha，presented to Kūtadanta by Bimbisāra．

The Buddha once stayed there at theAmbalatthika pleasance，and there he preached the Kūtadanta Sutta．D．i．127．

khāṇumataka.p: [Khāṇumata+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who lived in Khāṇumata village.
a: ခါဏုမတရွာ၌နေသော၊ သူ။

ဧကသ္မိံ ခါဏုမတ္ထကေ ပတိတွာ၊ တစ်ခုသော သစ်ငုတ်ထက်၌ ကျပြီး၍။
